using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using CobolCS.Runtime;

namespace CobolCS.Generated;

/// <summary>手計算した業務契約を正式 ACCEPT 入力と型付き fake へ接続します。</summary>
public sealed class PaymentAdapter : IBusinessCaseAdapter
{
    /// <summary>Gets 内部変数名から独立した業務境界の版。</summary>
    public string ContractId => "payment-v1";

    /// <summary>正式入力を実行し、選択した業務結果と操作列だけを観測します。</summary>
    /// <param name="input">残高とケース専用の固定応答。</param>
    /// <returns>内部 snapshot 全体を含まない業務観測。</returns>
    public BusinessObservation Execute(BusinessCaseInput input)
    {
        var fake = new @N@ScriptedDependencies();
        input.External.BindNext<@N@@M@Request, @N@@M@Response>(
            "customer.lookup",
            fake.Expect@M@,
            request => new JsonObject { ["code"] = request.Argument0 },
            response => new @N@@M@Response("00", DependencyOutcome.Normal, Argument0: response["code"]!.GetValue<string>()));
        var result = new @N@Executor().Run(new @N@Input { AcceptInputs = new[] { input.Values["balance"]!.GetValue<string>() } }, fake);
        return new BusinessObservation(
            new JsonObject { ["fee"] = result.Snapshot.@FEE@.Decimal(2), ["errorCode"] = result.Snapshot.@CODE@ },
            input.External.Effects,
            result.Termination == TerminationKind.Goback ? "returned" : "unexpected",
            result.HasNoOpCalls);
    }
}
